# Low Key Capital

> Low Key Capital is a private holding and venture firm. It partners early and for the long term with a small number of founders building technology that earns trust.

- Legal name: Low Key Capital LLC
- Type: private holding company and boutique venture firm
- Focus: early-stage, long-term investments in ethical technology companies
- Locations: Charleston, SC; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay Area
- Portfolio: not publicly disclosed
- Inquiries: email@lowkeyinc.com
